format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-view-board id="b" aria-label="Заказы" fields='[{"key": "title", "label": "Заказ", "propertyType": "string"}, {"key": "status", "label": "Статус", "propertyType": "choice", "options": [{"value": "new", "label": "Новый", "scheme": "primary"}, {"value": "paid", "label": "Оплачен", "status": "success"}, {"value": "sent", "label": "Отправлен", "status": "info"}]}, {"key": "client", "label": "Клиент", "propertyType": "string"}, {"key": "amount", "label": "Сумма", "propertyType": "money", "currency": "RUB"}]' lanes='[{"value": "new", "total": 3, "totals": {"amount": {"RUB": "423070.00"}}, "records": [{"id": "o1001", "title": "Заказ № 1001", "status": "new", "client": "ООО «Северный склад»", "amount": "418000.00", "revision": 1}, {"id": "o1002", "title": "Заказ № 1002", "status": "new", "client": "Кафе «Лето»", "amount": "5070.00", "revision": 1}], "cursor": "c-new"}, {"value": "paid", "total": 2, "totals": {"amount": {"RUB": "204490.50"}}, "records": [{"id": "o1004", "title": "Заказ № 1004", "status": "paid", "client": "ИП Смирнова", "amount": "129990.50", "revision": 1}, {"id": "o1005", "title": "Заказ № 1005", "status": "paid", "client": "Типография «Оттиск»", "amount": "74500.00", "revision": 1}]}, {"value": "sent", "total": 0, "totals": {}, "records": []}]' options='{"lane_field": "status", "card_fields": ["client", "amount"], "totals": ["count", {"sum": "amount"}], "limits": {"paid": 1}, "per_lane": 2}' moves='{"sent": {"from": ["paid"], "reason": "В «Отправлен» — только из «Оплачен»"}}'></sf-view-board>

probes.title: Three lanes in the field's option order; the soft limit reads «2 / 1» highlighted; sums per currency; the empty lane says «Пусто»
«Новый» → «Отправлен» is refused by the host's rule: nothing moves, no move event
«Новый» → «Оплачен» shows at once, pale, sends move; settle-move applied keeps it
A move the host refuses goes back with the host's reason in the live region

steps.check: document.querySelector('#b [data-lane=paid] [data-id=o1004]') !== null && document.querySelector('#b .sf-view-board__live').textContent.includes('Заказ правит другой менеджер')
